title: Software Developer with JetBrains IDEs
subtitle: Learn to program the way professional developers work: in JetBrains IDEs, from your first Python script to Java, Kotlin, Go, Rust, the web and AI-assisted coding.
description: Start with Python in PyCharm, then keep your work in Git and learn the branching, review and release workflows teams use. Move on to Java and Kotlin in IntelliJ IDEA, JavaScript and TypeScript in WebStorm, Go in GoLand and Rust in RustRover. You finish with AI-assisted development: prompting coding assistants well, and reviewing, testing and debugging everything they suggest. Every course shows the IDE step by step, with its shortcuts for macOS, Windows and Linux, and has hands-on labs your instructors review.

title: Network Engineer
subtitle: Build, secure and automate networks with Cisco Packet Tracer, following the Cisco CCNA (200-301) exam topics from first principles to exam practice.
description: Learn how networks and the internet work, then address and subnet them, switch and route them, run their services, secure them and automate them with Python. Each course follows the published CCNA exam topics for its area, with labs in Cisco Packet Tracer, and the series ends with a full exam-preparation course. It's independent of Cisco and doesn't give you a Cisco certification, but it prepares you for the exam.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
subtitle: Protect, monitor and respond: the defensive skills security teams hire for, practised on your own machine and realistic sample data.
description: Begin with the foundations of security, then learn to monitor systems and triage alerts, respond to incidents, write code that resists common attacks, secure cloud systems and use machine learning to spot threats. The labs use your own machine and sample logs and code that come with each course, and finish with a hardened Linux server of your own.

title: Generative AI Engineer
subtitle: Go from understanding generative AI to building, grounding, automating and testing applications with the Claude API.
description: Understand how generative AI works and how to prompt it well, then build applications with the Claude API in PyCharm: chat, streaming, tools and structured data. Ground answers in your own documents with retrieval, build agents that use tools safely, and prove your application works with evaluations and tests.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
subtitle: Learn machine learning from its foundations and statistics to deep learning, and take models all the way to production.
description: Build models with scikit-learn on sound statistics, then implement the classic algorithms from scratch so you know what the libraries do. Learn classification and clustering, feature engineering and honest model evaluation, then train neural networks with TensorFlow and Keras, make deep networks train well, and apply them to real problems. You finish by tracking experiments with MLflow and serving models in production. Every course is hands-on in Python, with labs and a capstone project your instructors review.

title: Data Analyst
subtitle: Analyse data with spreadsheets, Python and SQL, back your conclusions with statistics, and present them in charts, dashboards and stories.
description: Clean, explore and chart data in spreadsheets and with pandas, query databases with SQL in DataGrip, and use statistics to tell real effects from noise. Then visualise data well in Python, build dashboards and tell stories with them, turn analyses into Streamlit apps, analyse product data with SQL, and use AI in business intelligence. Each course is hands-on, with datasets to work through and a project your instructors review.

title: AI for Business Leaders
subtitle: Understand AI, put it to work, and lead its use responsibly, without writing code.
description: Learn what AI is and isn't, how to choose where it pays off, how to use it every day at work, and how to govern it: fairness, transparency and the rules, including the EU AI Act.

title: MLOps Engineer
subtitle: Take machine learning models from a notebook to production: tracked experiments, automated pipelines, containers, serving and monitoring.
description: Learn the scripting, testing and CI/CD that production systems rely on, then track experiments and register models with MLflow, and learn the design patterns that keep ML systems maintainable. Package models in containers, run them on Kubernetes, serve them behind fast APIs and watch them for drift once they're live, and see how large organisations build data and ML platforms. Every course has hands-on labs and a capstone project your instructors review.

title: API Engineering with Python
subtitle: Build fast, tested web services with FastAPI, and take them to production.
description: Build web APIs with FastAPI: routing, validation with Pydantic, dependency injection and interactive docs. Learn concurrency and async Python so your services stay fast under load, then make them production-ready with authentication, databases, background tasks, tests and containers, and automate their testing and delivery with CI/CD. Every course is hands-on, with labs and a capstone project your instructors review.

title: Computer Science Foundations
subtitle: The computer science behind every system you build: algorithms, data structures, databases, concurrency, distributed systems and system design.
description: Learn the algorithms and data structures that make programs fast, how databases store, index and query data, how concurrent programs share work safely, how distributed systems stay consistent when machines and networks fail, and how to put it all together in a system design. Every course has hands-on labs and a project your instructors review.
